description: This file defines templates and structures related to threadblock-level matrix multiply-accumulate (MMA) operations with dequantization support, specifically for CUDA architectures. It includes converter structures for handling different memory and data layouts, supporting architectures like Volta and Turing+.

classes.name: SetConverters
classes.description: Template struct for setting data converters based on architecture and operation type.

classes.name: SetConverters<IteratorB, MmaOperator, arch::OpMultiplyAdd>
classes.description: Specialization for dequantizing after LDG and LDS for multiply-add operations.

classes.name: SetConverters<IteratorB, MmaOperator, arch::OpMultiplyAddDequantizeInterleavedBToA>
classes.description: Specialization for dequantizing after LDS with interleaved B-to-A conversion.

classes.name: DqMma
classes.description: Template struct for dequantized matrix multiply-accumulate operations with various configurations.

methods.name: SetConverters
methods.description: Template struct for setting data converters based on architecture and operation type.

methods.name: SetConverters<IteratorB, MmaOperator, arch::OpMultiplyAdd>
methods.description: Specialized converter setup for multiply-add operations with dequantization after LDG and LDS.

methods.name: SetConverters<IteratorB, MmaOperator, arch::OpMultiplyAddDequantizeInterleavedBToA>
methods.description: Specialized converter setup for interleaved B-to-A dequantization after LDS.

methods.name: DqMma
methods.description: Template for dequantized MMA kernel configuration.
